text:
anya: Heads-up — saw a regression in customer quality this morning. Pro-tier traffic got routed to a quantized variant in eu-west when regional capacity dropped; quality the app team saw was noticeably worse. We need a config pattern that avoids aggressive downgrades for paid tiers while still preserving cost SLOs. Thoughts?

mike: Ugh. Do you have the routing decision payload/trace?

anya: pasted snippet from trace: `route_decision: {tier: pro, region: eu-west, preferred_model: redwood-legal-16k, fallback: redwood-legal-8q, reason: capacity_pressure}`

raj: Short take — we should split controls into two orthogonal knobs: 1) tier routing priority (which model families are allowed per tier/region) and 2) fallback aggression (soft/hard, max token % allowed).

sophie: Agreed. For UI/API I'd expose a per-tier policy with three fields: `allowed_variants`, `fallback_strategy`, `quota_window`. Example idea: 

```yaml
pro:
  allowed_variants: [redwood-legal-16k, redwood-legal-8, redwood-legal-8q]
  fallback_strategy:
    mode: soft   # soft = gradual degrade, hard = immediate reject
    aggression: 0.2  # fraction of requests that can be downgraded per minute
    quality_floor: 0.85  # model quality score threshold
  quota_window:
    type: soft_grace
    grace_tokens: 50000
    window_seconds: 3600
```

mike: I like `aggression` + `quality_floor`. `aggression` lets infra throttle fallbacks instead of flipping a global switch. Also +1 on `grace_tokens` to let bursty tenants finish in-flight requests.

omar: Regional nuance: we should allow per-region overrides where a region with persistent capacity issues can auto-escalate `aggression` but not for enterprise. So policy inheritance: global -> tier -> region -> tenant.

raj: From enforcement side, we need two enforcement modes in the API: `enforce_strict` (reject beyond quota) and `enforce_meter` (route but tag and charge separate bucket). That helps product evaluate cost vs quality in canaries.

anya: Telemetry asks: tag every fallback event with `tier`, `region`, `variant_from`, `variant_to`, `policy_id`, and `decision_path`. Then we can build a dashboard slicing quality regressions by tier/region.

sophie: UX note: Console should surface a lightweight simulator: "If we set aggression=0.3 for pro in eu-west, estimate percent degraded and cost delta". Also an audit log per-tenant override.

deploy-bot: deploy started: policy-service v3.9.2 -> canary on us-east-1 (33% traffic).

mike: Implementation constraints: ranking code already picks compatible variants. We'll add a token-bucket per (policy_id, region) to implement `aggression` + a per-tenant `grace_tokens` counter. Keep it async where possible to avoid p99 blowups.

raj: One more: add `quality_shadowing` mode — send request to fallback variant in shadow and compute a quality delta before enabling it for a tier. This reduces surprises.

anya: OK action items: Sophie to draft console fields + simulator (eta 3 days), Mike/Omar to prototype token-bucket enforcement and region override rules (eta 1 sprint), Raj to spec telemetry events + quality_shadowing hooks. I'll sync with product to set defaults for free/pro/enterprise. Thanks. :thumbsup:
